events.title: Richard the Lionheart Defeats Saladin at Arsuf
events.description: During the Third Crusade, King Richard I of England led the Crusader army to a hard-fought victory over Saladin's forces at Arsuf, on the coast of the Holy Land. The Crusaders held formation under heavy harassment. Then they struck back with a decisive charge.
events.significance: The victory showed Richard's skill as a battlefield commander. It gave the Crusaders control of the coastal route toward Jaffa and damaged Saladin's reputation for invincibility.

events.title: Henry Every Captures the Ganj-i-Sawai
events.description: The English pirate Henry Every seized the Grand Mughal's treasure ship Ganj-i-Sawai in the Indian Ocean. The haul was among the richest in the history of piracy.
events.significance: The raid caused a diplomatic crisis between England and the Mughal Empire. It also set off one of the first global manhunts for pirates, and Every became a legend of the Golden Age of Piracy.

events.title: Garibaldi Enters Naples
events.description: Giuseppe Garibaldi entered Naples to a jubilant welcome. His volunteer force, the Red Shirts, had swept through Sicily and southern Italy and toppled the Bourbon Kingdom of the Two Sicilies.
events.significance: The conquest of the south was a decisive step in the Unification of Italy. It cleared the way for the Kingdom of Italy, proclaimed in 1861.
